channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Swiss Foreign Ministry says US-Iran talks will not take place as planned on Friday
item.description: Swiss Foreign Ministry announced that US-Iran talks at Bürgenstock will not take place as planned on Friday, Reuters reported on Friday.

item.title: British Pound slides to fresh low since April vs bullish USD amid UK political crisis
item.description: The GBP/USD pair attracts some follow-through selling for the third straight day and weakens further below the 1.3200 mark, hitting a fresh low since April during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: Gold weakens further below $4,200 as hawkish Fed and Iran uncertainty boost USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts sellers for the third straight day on Friday and weakens further below the $4,200 mark, hitting a fresh weekly low during the Asian session.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $70.50 due to Fed rate hike odds
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the third successive day, trading around $64.40 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Friday. Silver prices fall as the traders price in the hawkish sentiment surrounding the Federal Reserve (Fed) policy outlook.

item.title: UK Labour's Andy Burnham wins Makerfield by-election, paving way to challenge PM Starmer
item.description: Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham could now challenge UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer for the leadership of the governing Labour Party and the country after winning a parliamentary seat in northern England on Friday, CNN reported on Friday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index remains near 101.00 amid Fed hawkish outlook
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, remains flat after two days of gains and is trading around 100.83 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar drops to fresh low since April as hawkish Fed bets support USD
item.description: The NZD/USD pair turns lower for the third straight day following a modest Asian session uptick to the 0.5775 region and touches a fresh low since April 8 in the last hour.

item.title: Australian Dollar softens to near 0.7000 as Vice President canceled trip to talks with Iran
item.description: The AUD/USD pair loses momentum to near 0.7010 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) softens against the US Dollar (USD) after reports that US Vice President JD Vance canceled his trip to talks with Iran in Switzerland, raising concerns about the US-Iran peace deal.

item.title: Canadian Dollar declines as oil prices ease
item.description: USD/CAD rises for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.4140 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) struggles amid lower oil prices.

item.title: Japanese Yen recovers from two-year low vs USD as BoJ hike bets offset Japan's softer CPI
item.description: The USD/JPY pair is seen extending the previous day's late pullback from the 161.80 region, or a fresh high since July 2024, and drifting lower during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: WTI falls to near $75.00 as shipping conditions improve in Hormuz
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price edges lower during Friday's Asian trading hours, slipping to around $75.10 per barrel and reversing the modest gains recorded in the previous session.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama says ready to take strong action on speculative FX moves
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the government is prepared to take decisive action against speculative activity in the foreign exchange market.

item.title: Euro drifts higher above 1.1450 as US, Iran sign initial agreement to end war
item.description: The EUR/USD pair recovers some lost ground near 1.1460, snapping the two-day losing streak during the early Asian session on Friday.

item.title: BoJ’s Himino: Central bank likely to keep hiking rates based on economic, price, financial trends
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Deputy Governor Himino said on Friday that the Japanese central bank likely to keep hiking rates based on economic, price and financial trends. Himino added that currency moves may impact inflation expectations, core inflation, so we will keep monitoring developments closely.

item.title: BoJ Minutes: Members want more time to assess Middle East impact on Japan’s economy, prices
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) board members shared their views on the monetary policy outlook on Thursday, per the BoJ Minutes of the April meeting.

item.title: US ends naval blockade as Iran's supreme leader says Trump made deal 'out of desperation’
item.description: The US-Iran interim peace deal took effect, and shipping started returning to the Strait of Hormuz as the US dropped its naval blockade of Iran, Bloomberg reported on Thursday.

item.title: Japan’s National CPI rises 1.5% YoY in May, Core CPI climbs as expected
item.description: Japan’s National Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose by 1.5% YoY in May, compared to the previous reading of 1.4%, according to the latest data released by the Japan Statistics Bureau on Friday.

item.title: Gold declines to near $4,200 as hawkish Fed stance offsets support from US-Iran peace deal
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) loses ground to near $4,210 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal extends the decline after the US Federal Reserve (Fed) held interest rates steady in the June policy meeting but signaled rate hikes could come this year.

item.title: British Pound Sterling slides as cheaper Crude Oil masks the inflation pipeline
item.description: The Bank of England (BoE) delivered the hawkish hold the market expected on Thursday, and a second member of its Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) joined the push to raise the Bank Rate. Sterling fell anyway, sliding through the 1.3300 handle to its lowest level since early April, close to 1.3200.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Sellers eye break below 100-day SMA
item.description: The GBP/JPY retreats during the North American session on Thursday, down 0.21% as the Pound Sterling depreciates, despite the Bank of England (BoE) holding rates unchanged. At the time of writing, the cross-pair trades at 213.11 after peaking near 214.06.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar touches one-year high, Pound slips on BoE hold
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) firmed near 100.80 on Thursday, a level it hadn’t seen since May 2025, after the Federal Reserve (Fed) left interest rates unchanged in the 3.50%-3.75% range in Kevin Warsh’s first policy meeting as Fed Chair on Wednesday.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: US Dollar hits new YTD high past 0.8050
item.description: The USD/CHF pair rallies on Thursday to a new yearly high of 0.8059, surpassing March’s 31 previous peak of 2026 at 0.8042 as the Greenback stages a recovery amid hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) policy expectations, which drove the pair to reach the ‘inverted head-and-shoulders’ price target.

item.title: British Pound slips as BoE holds rates, Fed’s cautious stance supports Greenback
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades near a two-month close to the 1.3210 level on Thursday as the Pound Sterling (GBP) struggles to gain traction after the Bank of England (BoE) left interest rates unchanged at 3.75%, while the US Dollar (USD) remains supported by the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) cautious policy mes

item.title: Japanese Yen hovers near 40-year lows as risks of intervention rise
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) weakens on Thursday to a nearly two-year low against the US Dollar (USD), with the USD/JPY pair reaching 161.81, the highest level since July 2024's yearly high of 161.95, spurred by a hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) and the jump of US Treasury yields.

item.title: ECB’s Escriva sees energy inflation passing through to other sectors
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker José Luis Escrivá said on Thursday that higher energy costs are spreading to services and transport, while warning that the inflation outlook remains highly uncertain for the European Union (EU) at a speech in Barcelona.

item.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average nurses its Warsh hangover
item.description: Wall Street's blue-chip index spent Thursday picking up the pieces of Wednesday's hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) selloff, and not even a roaring chip trade could coax it back into the green.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG remains bearish below 200-day SMA, eyes on $61.50
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) price retreats on Thursday by nearly 2% as the Greenback refreshes year-to-date (YTD) highs, spurred by the Federal Reserve's (Fed) hawkish tilt, with nearly half of the board members supporting rate hikes in 2026.

item.title: Gold retreats as Fed shock sends US Dollar to YTD highs
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) price recoils by 0.70% on Thursday as traders continue to digest the Federal Reserve's (Fed) hawkish tilt, bolstering the Greenback and pushing it to a new year-to-date (YTD) high, a headwind for the yellow metal. The XAU/USD pair trades at $4,223 after reaching a high of $4,330.

item.title: Euro weakens to two-month low as Fed rate bets lift US Dollar
item.description: EUR/USD trades around 1.1470 on Thursday at the time of writing, down 0.22% on the day and hovering near its lowest level in two months.

item.title: Australian Dollar firms as US Jobless Claims point to steady labor market
item.description: The AUD/USD pair trades in a muted range near 0.7030 on Thursday, as the Australian Dollar (AUD) struggles to extend gains while the US Dollar (USD) remains supported by the latest United States (US) labor market data.
